item.title: Being unrecognized does not imply closure: Allahabad High Court directs seal on Madarsa to be lifted
item.description: “Madarsa will not be entitled to claim any government grant till it is recognized, and the Madarsa Education Board will not be obliged to permit the students of the Madarsa in examination conducted by the Madarsa Board.” The post Being unrecognized does not imply closure: Allahabad High Court directs seal on Madarsa to be lifted appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: SEBI issued Master Circular on Social Stock Exchange
item.description: SEBI has issued a Master Circular to consolidate and streamline the entire regulatory framework for the Social Stock Exchange. The post SEBI issued Master Circular on Social Stock Exchange appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Know why Delhi HC ruled marks ‘TIGER’ and ‘BRAND’ are generic; cannot be monopolized
item.description: “The mark ‘TIGER’ is publici juris and common to trade and is not uniquely identifiable with a particular goods or services of the Plaintiff.” The post Know why Delhi HC ruled marks ‘TIGER’ and ‘BRAND’ are generic; cannot be monopolized appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Bombay High Court: Assignment of leasehold rights not ‘Supply of Services’, Not taxable under GST
item.description: “The transaction pertained exclusively to transfer of benefits arising out of immovable property and had no nexus with the business of the petitioner company.” The post Bombay High Court: Assignment of leasehold rights not ‘Supply of Services’, Not taxable under GST appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: India’s Legal and Political Stalwarts gather to celebrate Arun Jaitley’s Life and Legacy at Sumant Batra’s Book Launch
item.description: Mr. Sumant Batra launches book titled “The Life and Legacy of Arun Jaitley” on the life and legacy of Late Mr Arun Jaitley. The post India’s Legal and Political Stalwarts gather to celebrate Arun Jaitley’s Life and Legacy at Sumant Batra’s Book Launch appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas welcomes Rohan Singh as a Partner in its Corporate Practice
item.description: With over 14 years of experience across private equity, M&A, joint ventures, and cross-border investments, Rohan’s return strengthens the firm’s corporate capabilities across multiple industry sectors. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas welcomes Rohan Singh as a Partner in its Corporate Practice appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: 30% Women’s Reservation to apply in Punjab & Haryana Bar Council Elections, Supervisory Committee to continue oversight: SC
item.description: The Court in Meena A Jagtap v. Bar Council of India, 2025 SCC OnLine SC 2749, directed that 30% posts of Executive Members along with that of ‘Treasurer’ of Gujarat High Court Bar Associations as well as all the District Bar Associations shall be exclusively earmarked/reserved for women advocates. The post 30% Women’s Reservation to apply in Punjab & Haryana Bar Council Elections, Supervisory Committee to continue oversight: SC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Indore Water Contamination Crisis: Madhya Pradesh HC directs safe keeping of relevant records, case documents
item.description: The respondents contended that there was a possibility of manipulation of the original relevant record relating to the tender of laying a separate drinking water pipeline in Bhagirathpura and sample reports of M.P. Pollution Control Board. The post Indore Water Contamination Crisis: Madhya Pradesh HC directs safe keeping of relevant records, case documents appeared first on SCC Times.
